# Macromedia
> Legacy web domain associated with Macromedia software and historical product information, now largely redirected into Adobe properties.

Macromedia was acquired by Adobe, and most authoritative product documentation, support, and developer resources for former Macromedia products now live on adobe.com. This index prioritizes Adobe-hosted documentation and support pages relevant to Macromedia-era products and technologies.

## Product Support
- [Adobe Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support.html): Central support hub for Adobe products, including legacy Macromedia software.
- [Download and Installation Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/download-install.html): Installation, activation, and download guidance for Adobe and legacy products.
- [Contact Adobe Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/contact.html): Official contact options for product, account, and technical support.
- [Adobe Community](https://community.adobe.com/): User forums covering legacy Macromedia and current Adobe products.
- [Adobe Genuine and Licensing Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/genuine.html): Licensing and authenticity guidance relevant to older Adobe software.
- [Account Management](https://account.adobe.com/): Adobe account portal for subscriptions, plans, and product access.

## Flash Player and Browser Runtime
- [Flash Player Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/flash-player.html): Support articles and troubleshooting for Adobe Flash Player.
- [Flash Player End of Life Information](https://www.adobe.com/products/flashplayer/end-of-life.html): Official retirement notice and policy details for Flash Player.
- [Flash Player Archive](https://helpx.adobe.com/flash-player/kb/archived-flash-player-versions.html): Archived Flash Player versions and historical release information.
- [Flash Player Issues on Windows](https://helpx.adobe.com/flash-player/kb/installation-problems-flash-player-windows.html): Troubleshooting installation and update problems on Windows systems.
- [Flash Player Issues on Mac](https://helpx.adobe.com/flash-player/kb/installation-problems-flash-player-mac.html): Troubleshooting installation and update problems on macOS systems.

## Adobe Director and Shockwave
- [Director Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/director.html): Product support resources for Adobe Director.
- [Shockwave Player Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/shockwave.html): Support information for Shockwave Player and related legacy content.
- [Director Community Discussions](https://community.adobe.com/t5/director/ct-p/ct-director?page=1&sort=latest_replies&lang=all&tabid=all): Community forum for Director troubleshooting and historical usage.
- [Archived Downloads Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/download-install/kb/downloaded-older-app.html): Guidance for accessing older Adobe installers where available.

## Dreamweaver
- [Dreamweaver User Guide](https://helpx.adobe.com/dreamweaver/user-guide.html): Official user documentation for Adobe Dreamweaver features and workflows.
- [Dreamweaver Tutorials](https://helpx.adobe.com/dreamweaver/tutorials.html): Learning resources for web design and site management in Dreamweaver.
- [Dreamweaver Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/dreamweaver.html): Troubleshooting, known issues, and support resources for Dreamweaver.
- [Dreamweaver Community](https://community.adobe.com/t5/dreamweaver/ct-p/ct-dreamweaver?page=1&sort=latest_replies&lang=all&tabid=all): Community discussions for Dreamweaver questions and solutions.
- [Dreamweaver Learn and Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/dreamweaver.html): Consolidated support entry point for Dreamweaver documentation and help.

## Fireworks and Legacy Web Graphics
- [Fireworks Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/fireworks.html): Legacy support resources for Adobe Fireworks.
- [Fireworks Community](https://community.adobe.com/t5/fireworks/ct-p/ct-fireworks?page=1&sort=latest_replies&lang=all&tabid=all): Community forum for Fireworks troubleshooting and historical workflows.
- [Creative Suite 6 Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/cs6.html): Support hub for CS6 applications including Fireworks and Dreamweaver.
- [Older App Downloads Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/download-install/kb/downloaded-older-app.html): Information about obtaining installers for discontinued Adobe applications.

## ColdFusion
- [ColdFusion Hub](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/coldfusion.html): Official support entry point for Adobe ColdFusion.
- [ColdFusion Documentation](https://helpx.adobe.com/coldfusion/user-guide.html): User guide and product documentation for ColdFusion.
- [ColdFusion Community](https://community.adobe.com/t5/coldfusion/ct-p/ct-coldfusion?page=1&sort=latest_replies&lang=all&tabid=all): Community discussions for ColdFusion development and administration.
- [ColdFusion Release Information](https://helpx.adobe.com/coldfusion/release-note/release-notes.html): Release notes and update details for ColdFusion versions.
- [ColdFusion Downloads](https://helpx.adobe.com/download-install/kb/coldfusion-downloads.html): Download resources and installer information for ColdFusion.

## Authorware and eLearning Legacy
- [Authorware Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support/authorware.html): Legacy support resources for Adobe Authorware.
- [eLearning Community](https://community.adobe.com/): Adobe community entry point for legacy eLearning product discussions.
- [Archived Product Downloads Help](https://helpx.adobe.com/download-install/kb/downloaded-older-app.html): General help for locating older Adobe installers and media.

## Developer and Technical Resources
- [Adobe Developer](https://developer.adobe.com/): Central developer portal for Adobe APIs, SDKs, and technical resources.
- [Adobe Experience League](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/): Product documentation, tutorials, and technical learning across Adobe platforms.
- [Adobe Open Source](https://opensource.adobe.com/): Open-source projects and engineering resources from Adobe.
- [Adobe API Documentation](https://developer.adobe.com/apis/): Directory of Adobe APIs and developer documentation.
- [Adobe GitHub Organization](https://github.com/adobe): Source repositories, SDKs, and sample code maintained by Adobe.

## Company and Historical Context
- [Adobe About](https://www.adobe.com/about-adobe.html): Corporate overview for Adobe, the company that acquired Macromedia.
- [Adobe Newsroom](https://news.adobe.com/): Official news, announcements, and historical corporate updates.
- [Adobe History and Milestones](https://www.adobe.com/about-adobe/our-company.html): Company background and milestones relevant to Adobe’s product evolution.
- [Wikipedia: Macromedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macromedia): General historical overview of Macromedia and its products.
